    SELECT
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = '有效'
),
valid_securities AS (
    SELECT
        sa.security_id
    FROM security_agreement sa
    WHERE sa.status = '有效'
),
coverage AS (
    SELECT
        so.agreement_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(so.covered_amount, 0)) AS total_covered
    FROM secured_obligation so
    JOIN valid_securities vs ON vs.security_id = so.security_id
    WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY so.agreement_id
)
SELECT
    va.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    va.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    va.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    va.contract_amount - COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) AS 保障缺口
FROM valid_agreements va
LEFT JOIN coverage c ON c.agreement_id = va.agreement_id
WHERE va.contract_amount - COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) > 0
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, 授信合同编号 ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS underprovisioned_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY underprovisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS obligor_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_amount,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY balance_multiple DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_code, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC;

WITH internal_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_val AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(ev.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(iv.max_internal - ev.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_val iv ON ca.collateral_id = iv.collateral_id
JOIN external_val ev ON ca.collateral_id = ev.collateral_id
WHERE ev.max_external < iv.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(lv.latest_valuation, 2) AS latest_valuation,
    ROUND(pl.total_pledged, 2) AS total_pledged,
    ROUND(pl.total_pledged - lv.latest_valuation, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) latest ON latest.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation lv
    ON lv.collateral_id = latest.collateral_id
   AND lv.valued_on = latest.max_valued_on
JOIN (
    SELECT cl.collateral_id, SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    JOIN status_catalog sc
        ON sc.entity = 'collateral_link'
       AND sc.status_code = cl.status
       AND sc.name_zh = '有效'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
) pl ON pl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE pl.total_pledged > lv.latest_valuation
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loan AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_total AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.loan_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gt.guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN borrower_loan bl ON bl.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor_total gt ON gt.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gt.guarantee_amount > bl.loan_amount
ORDER BY gt.guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party AS p
JOIN person_profile AS pp
    ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = (
        SELECT party_type
        FROM party_type_catalog
        WHERE name_zh = '个人客户'
    )
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egtc.name_zh AS exposure_group_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS distinct_member_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg
    ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egtc
    ON egtc.group_type = eg.group_type
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type,
    egtc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY distinct_member_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS member_party_id,
    p.display_name AS member_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
   AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
   AND rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca_s
    ON ca_s.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca_t
    ON ca_t.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH active_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = '有效'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(le.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(le.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM active_guarantees ag
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ag.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_exposure le ON le.party_id = ag.party_id
WHERE ag.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(le.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
)
AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

WITH overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal IS NOT NULL
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
overdue_party AS (
    SELECT
        party_id,
        SUM(total_overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM overdue_borrowers
    GROUP BY party_id
)
SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS obligor_party_id,
    op.total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN overdue_party op ON op.party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, op.total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND sc.status_code = ca.status
WHERE sc.name_zh = '正常'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg
    ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    (
        SELECT SUM(lbs.overdue_principal)
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
          AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
          AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    ) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ma.issuer_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
        AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
        AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    institution_id,
    ROUND(tier1_capital * 1.0 / risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot
WHERE risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND risk_weighted_assets <> 0
  AND tier1_capital IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = cs.as_of_date
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id), 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset AS ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot AS phs
JOIN managed_asset AS ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit AS td
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution AS i
    ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM main.service_operator so
JOIN main.staff_member sm
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
  AND so.authority_level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

WITH loan_prov AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount AS under_provision
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
),
inst_under AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(under_provision) AS total_under
    FROM loan_prov
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
inst_net AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.net_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs
        ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
)
SELECT
    iu.institution_id,
    inn.institution_name,
    iu.total_under,
    inn.net_assets,
    ROUND(iu.total_under * 1.0 / inn.net_assets * 100, 2) AS pct_of_net_assets
FROM inst_under iu
JOIN inst_net inn ON inn.institution_id = iu.institution_id
WHERE inn.net_assets IS NOT NULL AND inn.net_assets <> 0
ORDER BY pct_of_net_assets DESC, iu.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM main.risk_classification rc
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.loan_id) AS nonperforming_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = ds.as_of_date
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY ca.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH loan_principal AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ld.closed_on IS NULL
      AND ld.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_loan AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lp.total_principal) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_principal lp
        ON lp.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_rwa AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(risk_weighted_assets) AS total_rwa
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    il.total_principal_balance,
    ir.total_rwa,
    ROUND(il.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ir.total_rwa * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN institution_loan il
    ON il.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN institution_rwa ir
    ON ir.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ir.total_rwa IS NOT NULL
  AND ir.total_rwa <> 0
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction AS pi
JOIN loan_drawdown AS ld
    ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN status_catalog AS sc
    ON sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
   AND sc.status_code = ld.status
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND sc.name_zh = '正常'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
    SUM(pms.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    fs.net_assets AS net_capital,
    fs.total_assets AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pms.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pms
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pms.institution_id
JOIN regulatory_event_catalog rec ON rec.event_code = pms.event_code
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pms.institution_id
WHERE rec.rule_family = '审慎监管指标'
  AND pms.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pms.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH
-- 监管报送逾期未完成记录：按机构统计
reg_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE event_code IN (
        SELECT event_code FROM regulatory_event_catalog WHERE rule_family = '监管报送'
    )
      AND status_code <> 'COMPLETED'
      AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL
      AND deadline_date < date('now')
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
-- 拨备不足借据：拨备缺口 = 应提 - 已提
prov_short AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount AS shortfall,
        ps.required_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
),
prov_agg AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS short_loan_cnt,
        SUM(shortfall) AS total_shortfall,
        AVG(required_amount) AS avg_required
    FROM prov_short
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_cnt AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(pa.avg_required, 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    pa.short_loan_cnt AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(pa.total_shortfall, 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM reg_overdue ro
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
JOIN prov_agg pa ON pa.institution_id = ro.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_cnt >= 25
ORDER BY pa.total_shortfall DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN regulatory_event_catalog rec ON rec.event_code = g.event_code
WHERE rec.rule_family = '公司治理'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_unrelated_relation_count
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_count DESC, relation_type_count DESC, customer_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
    WHERE pc.status = '有效'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
op_risk_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_op_risk_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = '有效'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(cs.cardholder_count, 0) AS cardholder_count,
    COALESCE(ors.exception_amount, 0) AS exception_amount,
    ors.valid_op_risk_count
FROM op_risk_stats ors
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ors.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON cs.institution_id = ors.institution_id
WHERE ors.valid_op_risk_count >= 43
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 0) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce
    ON pce.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND pce.exception_flag = 1
JOIN regulatory_event_catalog rec
    ON rec.event_code = pce.event_code
    AND rec.rule_family = '产品行为'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT
        originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(issued_amount, 0)), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset
    GROUP BY originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND exception_flag = 1 THEN COALESCE(amount_value, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_record_count
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(a.asset_count, 0) AS asset_count,
    COALESCE(a.total_issued_amount, 0) AS total_issued_amount,
    COALESCE(c.valid_record_count, 0) AS valid_record_count,
    COALESCE(c.exception_amount, 0) AS exception_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN asset_stats a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN custody_stats c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.exception_record_count >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
